mentions.name: Todo driven development
mentions.description: This is an enhancement to the Gleam test runner gleeunit that adds "todo" as a separate reporting category. Instead of unfinished work showing up as failing tests, incomplete tests appear as yellow "todo" results, so when implementing part of a feature you can immediately see whether you get actual passing tests or real failures, without reading failure details to separate todos from genuine breaks.
mentions.problem: Failing-test counts don't distinguish placeholder "todo" tests from real failures, so you can't tell at a glance whether a partial implementation was correct and have to read the details of the failures instead.
mentions.source_excerpt: the one I really want to get over the line is "Todo driven development" - An edit to the gleam test-runner gleeunit that adds "todo" as a separate reporting category.
mentions.author: eterm
